items.question: How do I book an appointment at ZOMAK Medical Clinic?
items.answer: You can book an appointment by contacting the clinic by phone, visiting the clinic website, or using the booking options provided on the ZOMAK platform.

items.question: Do ZOMAK clinics accept walk-in patients?
items.answer: Some ZOMAK locations provide walk-in and same-day care depending on provider availability, clinic hours, and patient volume. We recommend calling ahead before visiting.

items.question: Which locations are part of the ZOMAK clinic network?
items.answer: ZOMAK includes Zomak Medical Clinic - Griffin Road, Zomak Medical Clinic - Centre St, Zomak Medical Clinic - Lewisburg, Zomak Medical Clinic - Northmount, and Zomak Medical Clinic - Fairview.

items.question: What services are available?
items.answer: Available services include family practice, pediatric care, internal medicine, women’s and men’s health, aesthetics, visa medical exams, medical piercings at Centre St., and driver’s medical exams.

items.question: Can I get directions to a specific clinic?
items.answer: Yes. Each location includes a Get Directions option so patients can quickly open the clinic address in Google Maps.

items.question: How should I contact a clinic directly?
items.answer: Each clinic location includes its direct phone number, fax number when available, website link, and directions so you can contact the right location quickly.

items.question: Do you offer follow-up support after a visit?
items.answer: Yes. Patients can contact the clinic after their visit with questions, next steps, or follow-up needs related to their care.
